policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Sweden Abroad guidance expressly gives these Swedish-passport short-visitor exemptions.
conditions: BA, XK, PA and TN: up to 90 days on the respective Sweden Abroad guidance. PA also requires at least six months' passport validity and proof of onward travel; TN requires a passport valid at least three months from entry.
TN's free entry stamp is for tourism. Work, residence, special documents, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Swedish or destination-authority guidance expressly identifies these border-issued visitor visa routes.
conditions: KM: obtain the visa on arrival at Prince Said Ibrahim International Airport. KH: a Swedish tourist may obtain the visa online or at arrival; this policy records the available arrival route.

CI: online pre-enrolment, approval and payment are required before boarding; complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued. This is preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special documents, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Swedish ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Sweden Abroad establishes the Swedish visitor-visa requirement, while Cuba's official tourism guidance states that the internet tourist visa replaces the Tourist Card.
conditions: A Swedish citizen needs a Cuban visa. Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel through the official Cuban route; Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is a separate arrival form.
Work, residence, special documents, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Swedish passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Côte d'Ivoire evisa, but the official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
